title: M23/AFC Authorities Impose Media Blackout on Political Coverage in Bukavu
detail: Patrick Busu Bwa Ngwi Nshombo, the M23/AFC-appointed governor of South Kivu, summoned Bukavu media executives on Aug 19 and warned of harsh sanctions unless outlets accepted new conditions, including indefinite bans on broadcasting political debates and covering DRC government news. On Aug 22, the local press union suspended Bukavu FM's political program "Samedi Miracle" for 30 days and host Claude Kashonga for 45 days after he criticized M23/AFC officials' occupation of private homes in the city. CPJ called on rebel authorities to lift the restrictions.

media.caption: CPJ alert on the M23/AFC political-coverage ban and journalist suspension in Bukavu
